sys_properties.name: x_snc_uibm.perf.threshold.load
sys_properties.description: Alert if page load time exceeds N milliseconds. Default: 5000

sys_properties.name: x_snc_uibm.perf.threshold.tasks
sys_properties.description: Alert if long task count exceeds N. Default: 10

sys_properties.name: x_snc_uibm.perf.threshold.memory
sys_properties.description: Alert if JS heap memory exceeds N MB. Default: 200

sys_properties.name: x_snc_uibm.ci.gate_threshold
sys_properties.description: CI/CD gate complexity score threshold. Pages above this score FAIL the gate. Default: 60

sys_properties.name: x_snc_uibm.ai.enabled
sys_properties.description: Enable BYOK component analysis via GenAI Controller. Default: false (rule-based recommendations work without this)

sys_properties.name: x_snc_uibm.ai.batch_size
sys_properties.description: Components per LLM batch for BYOK analysis. Default: 5

sys_properties.name: x_snc_uibm.safemode.max_idle
sys_properties.description: Auto-disable Safe Mode after N minutes idle. Default: 30
